title: Company Objectives: Pillar Mapping and Cross-Functional Governance
creator: Ava Santiago
description:
Purpose: Create a tight mapping between the company-level strategic objectives (3 pillars) and the set of cross-functional initiatives for 2026-Q2/Q3, plus a governance model to make trade-offs visible and reduce duplication.

Scope: Define pillars and success metrics, map existing initiatives (Hosted API, Dedicated, Private, Console, Optimize) to pillars, assign initiative owners and a RACI for cross-team decisions, create a bi-weekly governance forum for prioritization and risk escalation. Output deliverables: pillar deck, initiative map (owner + status + dependencies), prioritized roadmap view, governance playbook and communication plan.
activity_log: 2026-03-01 — Ticket created by Ava Santiago: initial problem statement and scope. Linked to Company Strategy 2026 initiative.

2026-03-03 — Kickoff with Eng, Design, Research: agreed to limit top-level pillars to three customer-facing outcomes (Performance, Reliability, Developer Efficiency). Action: each wing to submit candidate initiatives by 2026-03-10.

2026-03-08 — Product intake review: collected 27 candidate initiatives across teams. Noted two overlapping items between Dedicated autoscaling and Serving runtime batching. Assigned to Eng owners for technical consolidation.

2026-03-10 — Pillar metrics draft posted to shared drive (link below). Decision: use latency P50/P95, SLO breach frequency, cost-per-inference, and developer time-to-ship as primary success metrics. Feedback requested by 2026-03-12.

2026-03-12 — PM sync: Liam proposed a governance cycle of bi-weekly 'Strategy Review' with rotating SR leads from Eng/Product/Design. Design requested a slot to escalate UX debt impacting adoption (Console onboarding).

2026-03-14 — Cross-functional working session: agreed on initial initiative categorization and RACI. Draft governance playbook approved for trial. Next: create prioritized roadmap and align release windows with runtime-1.18 and console-2026.04.
2026-03-14 — Blockers noted: capacity to run deep evals (need ENG-4021 capacity plan) and one delayed security KMS integration (security ticket to be raised).
decisions: Limit company objectives to three pillars to keep cadence and communication focused.
Pillars chosen: Performance (latency/cost), Reliability (SLOs/incident recovery), Developer Efficiency (API ergonomics, console onboarding).
Adopt bi-weekly Strategy Review forum with a lightweight RACI and rotating lead for the quarter.
Require every initiative to declare one leading success metric and one regression indicator before being accepted into the prioritized roadmap.
Consolidate overlapping Dedicated autoscaling + batching initiative into a single ‘Throughput & Cost’ epic owned by ENG-4021.
Trial governance playbook for one cycle before formalizing into company policy.
success_metrics: Reduce median hosting latency by 15% for production workloads by 2026-09-30 (Performance pillar)
Lower customer-facing SLO breach rate to <1/month per customer by 2026-09-30 (Reliability pillar)
Decrease new-customer first-successful-inference time from signup to first response by 30% by 2026-07-31 (Developer Efficiency pillar)
Model-level cost per 1k tokens reduced by 12% across targeted workloads by 2026-09-30 (Cost metric tied to Performance)
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: Engineering capacity constrained by concurrent runtime upgrades. Mitigation: prioritize experiments with highest ROI and defer lower-impact items; align with Dedicated capacity schedule.
Risk: Insufficient telemetry to measure new success metrics. Mitigation: coordinate with Observability (ENG-4217) to instrument dashboards before roadmap freeze.
Risk: Cross-team disagreement on priority leads to rework. Mitigation: tie decisions to agreed success metrics and escalate to Strategy Review with documented trade-offs.
next_steps: By 2026-03-18 — Product to publish finalized pillar definitions and measurement plan (owner: Liam).
By 2026-03-21 — Engineering owners (ENG-4021, ENG-4089) to submit consolidation plan for overlapping initiatives.
By 2026-03-25 — Design to deliver Console onboarding impact memo and suggested quick wins (owner: Maya Patel).
By 2026-03-28 — Run first Strategy Review forum; publish prioritized roadmap snapshot and RACI matrix.
By 2026-04-15 — Deliver governance playbook and communication plan for company town hall.
